description: Find labsUI components, blocks, hooks and helpers by name, export (useModal) or intent (date range, toast promise), and recipes for a whole app (blog, shop): a prompt checked on a fresh app with the items it used. All words must match, best match first; no query lists everything. Returns one line per hit: name, kind and summary, and says how many a limit left out. Start here when you don't know an item's name, then call view on the hits.

kind.description: Only this kind: component (primitive), block (composed section), hook, helper, setup or recipe (a prompt for a whole app).

limit.description: Most results to return. Default: 12 with a query, everything without one.

query.description: Words to match. Empty lists everything.

name: search
